name: form
useFor: Build a validated form with react-hook-form: wrap it in Form with the useForm result, give each field a FormField with a render function returning FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl around the one control, then FormDescription and FormMessage. FormControl passes the id, the described-by ids and aria-invalid to the control, so the red edge and the message appear together. Finish with one full-width default Button of type submit, showing a Spinner while it works.
constraints: A red label on an invalid field
Validating on every keystroke before the first submit
A submit button that stays enabled while the request runs
More than one purple pill in the form
source: Figma 427:2715: Create Agent Identity (handle check states, Creating Agent Identity...), Login
title: Form
description: react-hook-form fields laid out as the console's forms: a 14px label, the control, a muted description and a 12px red message.
